initialExam.title: SSC CGL 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Graduate Level Examination for recruitment to Group B and Group C posts in central government ministries and departments. Applications closed; Tier-I CBT expected in August-September 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.qualifications: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Tier-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (25Q), General Awareness (25Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25Q), English Comprehension (25Q). Tier-II: Mathematical Abilities & Reasoning, English, GK, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Tier-I: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 min (online). Negative: 0.50 marks. Tier-II: 390 marks, 2.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Tier-I (CBT) → Tier-II (CBT) → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Income Tax Inspector, Assistant Audit Officer, Sub-Inspector CBI, Assistant Section Officer, Tax Assistant, UDC
initialExam.careerGrowth: Can rise to Commissioner/Director level in respective departments through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register and fill form 3. Upload documents 4. Pay fee 5. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 4 to Pay Level 7 (7th CPC)

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical Benefits, Pension (NPS), LTC

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
